_comment: Sample document sets per change type for creating demo cases. Titles are fixed so the mock LLM fixtures (keyed by title/heading slugs) resolve. Paths are relative to the repo root.

product.title: International Instant Payments for SMB customers
product.description: Launch near-instant cross-border payments for existing SMB customers in Canada and Mexico via the public API channel, executed by third-party processor PayRail Inc. Phase one only; additional corridors after six months.

feature.title: Savings Goal feature in mobile app
feature.description: Add a Savings Goal feature to the existing mobile banking app letting existing retail customers schedule automatic transfers between their own chequing and savings accounts. Canada only, no third party.

process.title: Manual Wire Exception Handling process change
process.description: Move failed outbound wire exceptions from the automated repair queue to a manual handling process run by the wire operations team for six months while the repair engine is rebuilt. Domestic and cross-border wires affected.

vendor.title: New KYC Screening Vendor onboarding
vendor.description: Replace the in-house identity verification step for business onboarding with VerifyCo Ltd, a third-party KYC screening vendor providing document verification, beneficial-owner lookups and sanctions screening via API.

geography.title: Expansion of Business Accounts to Mexico
geography.description: Offer existing business operating accounts to Mexican-incorporated SMBs with a Canadian parent, including inbound and outbound MXN wires, through the existing relationship-manager channel.

customer_segment.title: Onboarding Money Service Businesses
customer_segment.description: Open the commercial operating account to licensed money service businesses (currency exchange and remittance agents) in Canada, a segment currently excluded by policy, subject to enhanced due diligence.

channel.title: WhatsApp Banking channel launch
channel.description: Enable balance enquiries, payee management and domestic transfers up to CAD 1,000 through a WhatsApp Business conversational channel operated with a messaging vendor, for existing verified retail customers.

transaction.title: Raise Daily Transfer Limit for retail
transaction.description: Increase the retail e-transfer daily limit from CAD 3,000 to CAD 10,000 and the per-transaction limit from CAD 3,000 to CAD 5,000 for customers with 12 months tenure and no fraud flags.
